scope: Mac-only per-process read-only aliases in LKL and Direct. Defaults and iPhone unchanged.
measurement: ART variants alternate by CLI/GCD and round. Desktop order is view CLI/GCD then flat GCD/CLI, same host binaries, one fresh filesystem per run. One run per entry/configuration; performance variability remains. Desktop phase includes startup, scripted checks, waits and shutdown. No profiler during these comparison runs. Memory means are sample means; peaks may miss shorter events.

report.scope: Independent runtime ARM64 blocks; no Linux/Android/iPhone integration
report.measurement: Three warm rounds per engine in separate processes, reversed process order for GCD. Same ARM64 bytes and checked results. Direct includes one-million-instruction slice entries; Unicorn includes register exchange. Memory phases include initialization and result verification, with arithmetic sample mean, sampled peak and latest; lifetime RSS peak is separate.

report.scope: Native single-CPU LKL with translated ARM64 userspace; selected workload only; iPhone unverified
report.measurement: Guest clock times 128 pipe round trips per memory case; excludes initial COW materialization. Selected preemption, translation and selected Linux mapping implementation included. Memory means are arithmetic sample means, including phase boundaries; sampled peaks can miss short peaks. Resident lifetime peak is separate.
